description: Implementation of UberReceivedPacketManager class managing packet reception and acknowledgment logic in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: UberReceivedPacketManager
classes.description: Manages received packet states and acknowledgments for QUIC connections, supporting multiple packet number spaces.

methods.name: SetFromConfig
methods.description: Configures the packet manager from QUIC configuration and perspective.

methods.name: IsAwaitingPacket
methods.description: Checks if a specific packet is awaiting acknowledgment.

methods.name: GetUpdatedAckFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the latest acknowledgment frame for a given packet number space.

methods.name: RecordPacketReceived
methods.description: Records the reception of a packet with associated header, time, and ECN codepoint.

methods.name: DontWaitForPacketsBefore
methods.description: Marks packets before a certain number as no longer awaited.

methods.name: MaybeUpdateAckTimeout
methods.description: Potentially updates acknowledgment timeout based on recent packet receipt.

methods.name: ResetAckStates
methods.description: Resets acknowledgment state for a given encryption level.

methods.name: EnableMultiplePacketNumberSpacesSupport
methods.description: Enables support for multiple packet number spaces, with checks.

methods.name: IsAckFrameUpdated
methods.description: Checks if acknowledgment frame has been updated.

methods.name: GetLargestObserved
methods.description: Returns the largest observed packet number for a given encryption level.

methods.name: GetAckTimeout
methods.description: Returns the acknowledgment timeout for a packet number space.

methods.name: GetEarliestAckTimeout
methods.description: Returns the earliest acknowledgment timeout across all spaces.

methods.name: IsAckFrameEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the acknowledgment frame for a space is empty.

methods.name: peer_least_packet_awaiting_ack
methods.description: Returns the least packet number awaiting acknowledgment in the default space.

methods.name: min_received_before_ack_decimation
methods.description: Gets the minimum number of received packets before decimating ACKs.

methods.name: set_min_received_before_ack_decimation
methods.description: Sets the minimum received packets threshold for ACK decimation.

methods.name: set_max_retransmittable_packets_before_ack
methods.description: Sets maximum retransmittable packets before ACK, conditional on Cobalt customizations.

methods.name: set_ack_frequency
methods.description: Sets the acknowledgment frequency.

methods.name: ack_frame
methods.description: Returns the current acknowledgment frame for the default space.

methods.name: GetAckFrame
methods.description: Returns the acknowledgment frame for a specified packet number space.

methods.name: set_max_ack_ranges
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of acknowledgment ranges.

methods.name: set_save_timestamps
methods.description: Configures whether to save timestamps for received packets.

methods.name: OnAckFrequencyFrame
methods.description: Handles reception of an ACK frequency frame, with validation.
